name: Hikikomori Sekai no Tantei Jikenbo #01 Maria-sama ga Miteta Satsujin Jiken
original_name: 引籠世界の探偵事件簿#01 マリア様がみてた殺人事件
source:
A retired detective passes a request to the young girls detective club. It's a letter with threats with the sender being one from the girls school. The three girls start investigation without awareness of the bloody consequences that they are to face.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
退休侦探向少女侦探社提出请求。这是一封充满威胁的信，发件人是女子学校的一名学生。三个女孩开始调查，却没有意识到她们将面临的血腥后果。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
